unsupported: The company launched in early 2019 as an independent operation after its founders spent years working as a subcontractor for various vendors producing hospitality furniture.
Primary customers are luxury hotel operators, designers, and contractors outfitting high-end properties.
The company has furnished guest rooms, lobbies, and public areas for nationally recognized hotel brands, though specific client names are not disclosed.
Sólido was started to give the team full control over quality, scheduling, and material selection after years of executing other vendors' designs.
The founders say the independent model lets them respond faster to design changes and maintain tighter oversight of craftsmanship from raw material to finished piece.
